title: File:D-Wave Two quantum computer inside the NASA Advanced Supercomputing Facility.jpg
desc: This is the D-Wave Two quantum computer inside the NASA Advanced Supercomputing Division building. The computer's housing is approximately 10 meters long and 10 meters wide. The NAS Division was also the site of the Pleiades supercomputer, which NASA decommissioned in December 2025.

title: File:D-Wave Two installed in the NASA Advanced Supercomputing Division.jpg
desc: This D-Wave Two quantum computer went online at the Ames Research Center in September 2013. It is housed in the NASA Advanced Supercomputing Facility at Ames Research Center in Santa Clara County, California.

desc: Photograph of the D-Wave TwoX 1000 Qubit quantum annealing processor chip mounted and wire-bonded in its sample holder.  This chip was introduced in 2015 and has 128,472 Josephson junctions
